name: broad_calendar
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday September 25, 2026. Scope: Calendar.

Window: Thursday September 24, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET), after-hours that evening, and overnight/pre-market news through Friday September 25, 2026 ~6:00 AM ET.

COVER EVERY ITEM BELOW (run a separate search for each bullet; do not skip one because another was rich)
Scheduled catalysts from the brief date through the next 5 NYSE sessions: earnings (date, BMO/AMC, EPS and revenue consensus) for US stocks >= $10B plus notable mid-caps, investor/analyst days, FDA PDUFA dates, major economic releases with consensus, Fed speakers, options expiry, index rebalances, lockup expiries.

Prefer primary sources and wire services (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's,
company press releases, SEC EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Fed releases).

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar, or
invent a concise one. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source in parentheses: (Reuters), (company 8-K), (CNBC interview),
  (Morgan Stanley note). "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor].
- Only facts published in the window below. Older background only if it is the direct cause of this
  move, and label it with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **COST** — Earnings [Calendar]
- Costco Wholesale is scheduled to report fiscal fourth-quarter results after the market close on Friday, September 25; consensus is **$6.66 EPS** and **$96.76 billion revenue** (QuarterCharts/Finnhub).

## **SNX** — Earnings [Software & SaaS]
- TD SYNNEX is scheduled to report fiscal third-quarter results before the market opens on Friday, September 25; consensus was **$4.75 EPS** and **$19.1 billion revenue**, while reported EPS was **$5.68** (QuarterCharts/Finnhub).

## **BXMT** — Earnings [Financials]
- Blackstone Mortgage Trust is scheduled to report results before the market opens on Friday, September 25; consensus was **$0.27 EPS** and **$78.51 million revenue** (QuarterCharts/Finnhub).

## **Micron Technology (MU)** — Earnings [Memory & Interconnect]
- Micron is scheduled to report fiscal fourth-quarter results on Wednesday, September 30; consensus is **$31.45 EPS** and **$50.8 billion revenue** (CMC Markets).

## **Cal-Maine Foods (CALM)** — Earnings [Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]
- Cal-Maine Foods is scheduled to report fiscal first-quarter results on Wednesday, September 30 (CMC Markets).

## **Conagra Brands (CAG)** — Earnings [Consumer Staples]
- Conagra Brands is scheduled to report fiscal first-quarter results on Wednesday, September 30 (CMC Markets).

## **FactSet Research Systems (FDS)** — Earnings [Software & SaaS]
- FactSet is scheduled to report fiscal fourth-quarter results on Wednesday, September 30 (CMC Markets).

## **Jabil (JBL)** — Earnings [AI Infrastructure]
- Jabil is scheduled to report fiscal fourth-quarter results on Wednesday, September 30 (CMC Markets).

## **Nike (NKE)** — Earnings [Consumer]
- Nike is scheduled to report fiscal first-quarter results on Thursday, October 1 (CMC Markets).

## **McCormick (MKC)** — Earnings [Consumer Staples]
- McCormick is scheduled to report fiscal third-quarter results on Thursday, October 1 (CMC Markets).

## **U.S. Economic Calendar** — Economic Releases [Macro / Calendar]
- **Monday, September 28:** No major U.S. economic reports are scheduled (Schaeffers Research).
- **Tuesday, September 29:** August **JOLTS job openings** and the September **consumer-confidence** report are scheduled (Schaeffers Research; CMC Markets).
- **Wednesday, September 30:** The **ADP employment report**, final second-quarter **GDP estimate**, wholesale and retail inventories, personal income, consumer spending, the August **core PCE price index**, and the Chicago Business Barometer are scheduled (Schaeffers Research; CMC Markets).
- **Thursday, October 1:** Weekly **initial jobless claims**, construction spending, the September **S&P Global manufacturing PMI**, the September **ISM manufacturing PMI**, and the September Challenger job-cuts report are scheduled (Schaeffers Research; CMC Markets).

## **U.S. Employment Report** — Economic Releases [Macro / Calendar]
- **Friday, October 2:** September nonfarm payrolls, the unemployment rate, average hourly earnings, and August factory orders are scheduled; the cited calendar gives a **0.3% month-over-month consensus forecast for average hourly earnings** (CMC Markets).

## **Strait of Hormuz / Iran** — Geopolitics [Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics]
- U.S. and Iranian negotiators were reported to be exploring a phased arrangement involving Tehran reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lifting its economic blockade; the report was published on September 24 (Reuters).
- September 24 closing prices were **$95.10 per barrel for WTI** and **$107.30 per barrel for Brent** (Investopedia).

## **U.S. Equities** — Regular Session [Macro / Calendar]
- On Thursday, September 24, the **S&P 500 fell 1.90 points, or less than 0.1%, to 7,704.13**, the **Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 161.61 points, or 0.3%, to 51,349.98**, and the **Nasdaq Composite rose 3.34 points, or less than 0.1%, to 26,939.37** (Associated Press).
- The **Russell 2000 fell 3.09 points, or 0.1%, to 2,835.57** on September 24 (Associated Press).

## **DG** — Analyst Action [Consumer Staples]
- HSBC upgraded Dollar General to **Buy** from its prior rating and raised its price target to **$160 from $125** on September 24 (Investrade).

## **GOSS** — FDA / Regulatory [Biotechnology]
- Gossamer Bio submitted a new drug application to the FDA for **seralutinib** for pulmonary arterial hypertension; the FDA is expected to determine filing acceptance later in 2026 (Investrade).

## **SPCX** — Lockup Expiry [Space / Communications]
- Approximately **328.4 million SpaceX shares** became eligible for trading after post-IPO lockup restrictions expired on September 24; at Wednesday’s close of **$148.36**, the shares were valued at approximately **$48.7 billion** (Yahoo Finance).
- Additional SpaceX lockup tranches are scheduled for **October 9 and October 24** (Yahoo Finance).

## **Options** — Expiration [Calendar]
- The September 25 options expiry was identified as the Friday expiry in an options-market brief dated September 24 (Saxo Bank).

## Coverage limitations
- The available search results did not provide verified details for every requested category, including a complete list of investor or analyst days, Fed speakers, index rebalances, all FDA PDUFA dates, all lockup expiries, or a fully sourced universe of U.S. companies with market capitalizations of at least $10 billion.
- The available earnings results did not include consensus EPS and revenue figures for every listed company, nor actual-versus-consensus results or guidance changes for the September 24 after-hours reports.
